formulas.formula: Lumpy client income, steady paycheck. Pay yourself a salary and never panic at tax time.
1. Setup: your tax set-aside %, the monthly salary you pay yourself, and your business account balance.
2. Clients: list your clients. Client Payments: log every payment. Tax set-aside is figured on each one.
3. Business Expenses: software, equipment, home office. These lower your taxes.
4. Quarterly Taxes: your estimated tax for each quarter, due dates, and what you paid.
5. Personal Budget and Personal Spending: live on your salary, not on whatever came in this month.
6. Monthly and Dashboard: income, taxes, salary and your buffer (how many months of salary you have saved).
All client money lands in your business account. You pay yourself the same amount every month. Smooth.
Move the tax set-aside to a separate savings account the day you get paid. Then it's never spent.
Aim for 3 months of salary in the business account. Slow months stop being scary.
US estimated taxes: Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15 and Jan 15. Check your own country's rules.
Clear the white cells on Clients, Client Payments, Business Expenses, Quarterly Taxes (paid) and Personal tabs.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid, healthy buffer, or money left.
Yellow: due soon, or a thin buffer.
Red: late, over budget, or something to check.
Be your own boss, and your own best payroll department.
